title: Prime-power coefficient Hom and tensor boundedness criterion
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, let $\ell$ be prime, $n\geq1$, $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, and $k=\mathbf F_\ell$. Let $K\in D^b(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ have bounded cohomology [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. The following are equivalent: (i) $K$ has finite Tor amplitude [def-kun-tor-amplitude]; (ii) $K\otimes^L_\Lambda k_X$ has bounded cohomology [def-kun-derived-tensor]; (iii) $R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(k_X,K)$ has bounded cohomology [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. When they hold there is a canonical isomorphism
$$R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(k_X,K)\cong K\otimes^L_\Lambda k_X$$
in $D^b(X_{\mathrm{et}},k)$. Neither excellence, invertibility of $\ell$ on $X$, nor constructibility of $K$ is required.

source.place: Expose XVII, Lemma 6.2.2.4, including the two-periodic comparison on pp. 294-295
